svg.title: Corroborate a missing TCP reply
svg.desc: In this synthetic example the client-side capture shows a SYN and a retry. A server-side capture sees both the SYN arrive and a SYN-ACK leave. Compare the return path with capture visibility before assigning a cause.

g.text: Synthetic example · one connection, two capture points
The SYN reaches this capture point.
A matching SYN-ACK is visible leaving.
Match connection, sequence and acknowledgment numbers, and time across both views.
Check return-path reachability, mirror coverage and capture drops before assigning loss.
